We propose a multi manifold metric learning method for image set based classification, which can effectively exploit discriminative and class-specific information for image set classification and achieve state of the art results on several benchmark datasets.
we propose a novel multi manifold deep metric leaning method to learn multiple nonlinear transformations to nonlinearly map image instances to a shared feature subspece for image set classification.

we propose a MDMML method to learn nonlinear mappings of multiple sets of image samples into a shared feature space for the task of image set classification, and that the proposed MMDML method achieves the state-of-the-art performance on five widely-used datasets.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is the state of theart method for image set recognition, which is a significant improvement over the state of the arts.
the method proposed in this paper is able to achieve state of the art results on five datasets for image set classification.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our method can be used to learn multiple sets nonlinear transformations to map multiple sets of images into a shared feature space, under which the nonlinear manifolds of different class can be maximally separated.
our method can effectively learn a shared subspace for image set classification by jointly considering the manifold margin and the class-specific information.

our MMDML method is the first to use deep learning to model the non-linearity of samples in image set classification and it can effectively capture the discriminative and class-specific information from image sets, which leads to superior classification accuracy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
deep learning can be used for manifold learning and manifold can be effectively incorporated into deep learning for image set based recognition.
deep metric learning can effectively be used to learn nonlinear transformation for image sets, and the learned nonlinear transformation can effectively be used for image set classification.
the proposed MMDML method is a general and effective framework for image set classification and can be easily extended to other related applications.
